items.title: Perceived delay: naive vs. optimistic, as network latency changes
items.description: Drag the network round-trip time and watch how long the user actually perceives waiting, for the naive (wait-for-confirmation) approach versus the optimistic-update approach. The default reproduces the opening scenario's exact 800ms case — the naive perceived delay always equals the network latency; the optimistic perceived delay stays at zero regardless of how slow the network gets.
